name: Way Tempting
sire: By AINT HE TEMPTING SI 92 (2020). 6 wins, $262,419, Southern California Derby [G2], 2nd Ed Burke Million Fut. [G1]. Brother to AINT SHE TEMPTING SI 97. His first foals are yearlings of 2026. Son of champion TEMPTING DASH SI 112; sire of 55 stakes winners, including KISS MY HOCKS SI 109 (Champion, $1,199,385 [G1]), DASHING TRES SI 104 ($1,047,227 [G1]), AINT SHE TEMPTING SI 97 ($727,427 [G2]), HOTSEMPTING SI 99 ($682,793 [G1]), LOVETHEWAYYOULIE SI 96 ($456,472 [G1]), GETTHERE FAST SI 106 ($441,919 [G2]).

dam1.head: Most Delightful Way SI 85, by One Famous Eagle. Unplaced. Dam of 3 foals of racing age, 1 to race.

dam2.head: A DELIGHTFUL LEGACY SI 105, by First Down Dash. 4 wins in 6 starts at 2, $179,153, All American Juvenile Inv. [R] [G3], finalist in Los Alamitos Million Futurity [G1]. Half sister to A DELIGHTFUL DASHER SI 102 (Champion, $1,660,525 [G1]), HES MY DASHER SI 102 (Champion, $575,774 [G1]). Out of FORTUNE OF DELIGHT SI 107 (AQHA Dam of Distinction, Broodmare of the Year, $100,269). Dam of 34 foals to race, 22 winners, 24 ROM–
